description: Aged creditors report: outstanding bills grouped by supplier, bucketed by days past due (current/not-yet-due, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+). Use when the user asks "who do I owe", "what bills are due", "show aged payables", or is planning supplier payments. Read-only.

as_of_date.description: Ages TODAY's open bills as at this date (YYYY-MM-DD). It is not a historical snapshot: bills paid since that date are not included. Defaults to the end of the user's working period, which is today when they are in the current period.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

contact_id.description: Optional supplier contact ID to scope the report
